## Summary

Recover original448421e viewer code-entry transitions.

```text
open code → fade toolbar controls separately; delete card/detail previews after fade
Back → fresh page one; source sort x616.55
local list → sort x501.6
async read/cancel → dispose old pending panes before rebuilding; invalidate stale request
```

PR #90 has landed; this PR targets master.

## Evidence

- **Before:** code entry faded one content group and retained its preview panes.
  **After:** model/browser checks verify separate queues, preview disposal, fresh page-one return, source control ordering and one-time prompt clearing.
- Formatting, TypeScript,560 rule/parser tests (6,543 assertions), production build and all14 affected native/mock browser cases pass (2.1minutes), without skips. Existing stalled crypto cancellation, persistence, pane ownership and in-game editing remain verified. Captures inspected.
- Controller/pane model match original448421e. Decompiled small/detail entry, ReturnToViewTanksFromSearch, code submission and focus handlers checked. Prior loading cleanup, description callbacks and signed8.8 alpha corrections retained.
- Five model cases also protect hidden-control deferral, delayed input flags and the source direct-Back delete-on-requeue quirk. Async Web Crypto cleanup is an explicit browser lifetime adapter; it preserves fresh results without changing direct Back semantics.
- Following original navigation/hover/rejection/save/profile checkpoints, the visible mock code-input backdrop difference and synchronized original-runtime comparison remain outstanding. Full viewer/game parity is unproven.

Revert restores the previous whole-content code-entry transition.

local / sort / code / cards / detail / page

  → rebuild or transfer the existing pane previews

Revert restores bounds-derived navigation guards.

**Blast Radius:** viewer

Changes page/detail navigation and preview refreshes. No profile, simulation, generated data or original media changes.
